title: AMRUT Mission (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation):
summary: Schemes — AMRUT Mission (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation):

items: o Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
o Objective: Improve urban infrastructure in 500 cities with a population of 1 lakh (75,000 for
riverside cities), focusing on water supply, sewage systems, green spaces, and parks.
 Rejuvenate water bodies and increase greenery.
o AMRUT 2.0 (1oct. 2021-2026): Expands to 4,700 urban local bodies with a focus on sustainable
urban development, smart water management, and eco-friendly infrastructure.
o PPP Mode: Mandatory for cities with populations over 10 lakh.
o Funding: Central and state governments with active involvement of local urban bodies for
